facts: Nvidia's neocloud commitments fell to $32bn at end-October, from $36bn three months earlier
Credit support totals $118bn, of which $105bn supports OpenAI's PORTS-Pike campus in Ohio
Revenue was $115.8bn for the three months to 25 October, up 103% year on year
Guidance for the current quarter is $130bn, plus or minus 3%
None of the $32bn falls due before fiscal 2028
Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR signed compute financing platform agreements with Nvidia in August; Nvidia can back up to a quarter of any deal

caption:
Nvidia's neocloud commitments fell to $32bn at end-October, from $36bn three months earlier.

Credit support totals $118bn, and $105bn of that backs OpenAI's PORTS-Pike campus in Ohio. Interim CEO Colette Kress says Nvidia is rigorously evaluating future commitments. Revenue for the quarter was $115.8bn, up 103%.

On the rental side, our index puts the H100 on-demand median at $3.9 per GPU-hr, up from $3.49 in October.

Data: Coloprice GPU index, 16 Nov 2026. Source: Capacity Media, 19 Nov 2026. Sources on the last slide.
